ment above the AR of non-lactating women, and a PRI of 2 mg day1 is set for lactating women. Based on data from 13 surveys in
nine countries of the EU, riboﬂavin intake mean estimates ranged across countries from 0.6 to 1.2 mg day1 in infants (<1 year),
from 0.9 to 1.4 mg day1 in children aged 1 to <3 years, from 1 to 1.8 mg day1 in children aged 3 to <10 years, and from 1.2 to
2.2 mg day1 in children aged 10 to <18 years. Riboﬂavin intake mean estimates ranged between 1.4 and 2.2 mg day1 in adults.
